audience.programmeDescription: Duitslandstudies (German Language and Culture) at the University of Amsterdam examines German-speaking societies through history, politics, literature and film. Students develop their German, spend a semester at a German-speaking university and write a thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers courses related to European history, politics, film and literature. These cover topics such as European integration and German Expressionist cinema. They cannot form a curriculum that follows German society, politics and cultural works in depth across several years.

curriculum.limitation: The first-year language diagnostic and ongoing tutoring are required and carry no credits.
